title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of chronic kidney disease and blood pressure.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding his end stage renal disease. He reports feeling generally stable with no new acute concerns. He continues to manage symptoms associated with his chronic kidney disease. He notes that his blood pressure has been well-controlled at home with his current regimen. He denies any recent changes in appetite, weight, or significant fatigue.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily, Sevelamer 800mg with meals.

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Vital signs show blood pressure of 132/82 mmHg. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema noted in lower extremities.

Assessment
1. End stage renal disease
2. Hypertension

Plan
Continue current medications for hypertension and management of chronic kidney disease. Patient instructed to monitor blood pressure daily and report any significant fluctuations. Follow up in three months for lab work and clinical review.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
